notes.title: fix part of the bugs
notes.content:
1. Fix the issue where some equipment prefixes/suffixes cannot be obtained.

notes.title: map feature functionality is online, with added support for Korean and Spanis
notes.content:
1. The special map enhancement effects are now online and active.

notes.title: Added 3 new maps, adjusted minion AI
notes.content:
1. Added 3 new maps: Grassland, Forest Ruins, Snowfield. Specific map effects are still in development and will be released soon.
2. Adjusted minion AI for more flexible skill casting. Significant enhancement to combat effectiveness.

notes.title: Updated global leaderboard
notes.content: Added global leaderboard feature on the main deity interface.

notes.title: Updated the Endless mode rank leaderboard system.
notes.content:
Added the display of the Steam names and Endless mode ranks of the global top 123 players for all maps' endless modes.
Next, we will update the detailed leaderboard feature.

notes.title: February 16th Update
notes.content:
1.Added four new mage skills.
2.Adjusted enemy status display.
3.Fixed bug where enemies were being killed upon spawn.

notes.title: Added multiple mage skills.
notes.content:
1. Added 3 new mage skills.
2. Added status effects.
3. Display enemy status effects (Incomplete).

I was busy during the Chinese New Year and had to deal with a relative's passing. So, I didn't have time to work on the game. Now everything is settled, and I'll resume working on it tomorrow.

notes.title: Fixed the insta-kill bug in endless mode. Thanks to shep7000 for the information
notes.content: Fixed the insta-kill bug in endless mode. Thanks to shep7000 for the information. Now it's time for the Chinese New Year celebration! Haha

notes.title: Add 28 achievements
notes.content:
1. Adding 28 new achievements and rewards related to the endless mode of the map.
PS: Tomorrow is the Chinese New Year, from the 30th of the lunar month to the 2nd of the first lunar month. I estimate that I can only update once.

notes.title: Endless mode added to each map
notes.content:
1. Added endless mode to individual maps
2. Adjusted all endless mode rewards and probabilities
3. Adjusted the release frequency of movement skills
4. Teleportation card now supports Warrior's movement skills

notes.content:

2. Added skills that can be used in conjunction with movement skills

notes.title: New Warrior Class (Work in Progress)
notes.content:
1. New Warrior Class
Currently in development, playable but subject to adjustments at any time.

notes.title: Sound effects are finally here!
notes.content: Added sound effect system, old players can finally turn on the sound.

notes.title: January 30th Update
notes.content:
1. Added visual effects to all status effects.
2. Adjusted enemy health regeneration speed.
3. Fixed bug causing incomplete counting in the achievement system.

notes.title: January 29th Update
notes.content:
1. Added Wormhole skill as the default active skill.
2. Added three learnable skills.
3. Added two red-tier gloves.
4. Changed the magic attack bonus from gems to percentage-based.
5. Adjusted the calculation method for enemy physical and magic defense.

notes.title: January 28th Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where slow and freeze effects couldn't be removed in some situations.
2. Fixed the problem where damage received by characters wasn't displayed in the damage display situation.

notes.title: January 26th Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where minimum attack power and attack speed were not displayed in English.
2. Adjusted initial equipment.
3. Endless mode is now enabled by default.
4. Added boss summoning in endless mode. A boss will be summoned every 500 enemies generated. Currently, there is only one boss, and more will be added in the future.
5. Added the rare card "Echo," which increases the probability of skills being cast multiple times. Note that the map will spawn it. "Echo" also affects enemies.
6. Adjusted the multiplier for enemies gaining map buffs to 3x. For example, if a map spawns a buff of +5% HP and it remains uncollected for 15 seconds, enemies will gain 15% increased health.
Once again, thank you to all the amazing friends for their suggestions and assistance.

notes.title: Added ring equipment.
notes.content:
Added ring equipment, now you can have one less empty equipment slot.
There are many ideas for ring equipment. Currently, 6 rings have been added, which not only help you increase the chance of getting a rare card when drawing, but also have some interesting functions, such as exchanging mana for health, exchanging health for critical strike chance, etc., emphasizing an equivalent exchange.
Hope it brings more gameplay.

notes.title: January 14th Update

notes.title: January 13th Update (Advance Notice)
notes.content: Updated the achievement progress chart artwork. I have some personal matters to attend to in the coming days, so the updates will be a bit slower.

notes.title: Shep7000 reported an error update
notes.content:
First of all, a big thanks to the player shep7000 for his help. It was his repeated testing that helped identify and fix this issue.
1.A bug where some players were unable to retrieve Steam achievement data.
Since the player community is still relatively small, I'm not certain if this fix is comprehensive. If you encounter any related issues, please leave a comment. I would be extremely grateful for your feedback.

notes.title: Updated on January 10th
notes.content:
Thanks to player "shep7000" and group friend "玉" for the bug report.
1. Three new pets have been added, which can be obtained through achievements. They have more attribute bonuses, a larger pickup range and faster movement speed. Can help pick up items more efficiently.
2. Fixed the problem of being unable to exit the game when unable to connect to steam.
3. Fixed the bug that the card drawing interface would occasionally get stuck and go back.
4. Fixed the bug that could copy items
Thank you again for your support

notes.title: January 9th update
notes.content:
New Achievement and Achievement Reward System (Incomplete)
Thanks for everyone's support. The achievement reward system has many features still in development. Recently, my wife's grandfather has been hospitalized, and we've been taking care of him. There's a lot going on, so the update progress might be a bit slower. Apologies for that.
PS：Achievement system in English is not ready yet. Will be updated as soon as possible.

notes.content:
